verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that within one Adyen integration a platform can shift from Adyen-managed options to self-controlled ones: hosted vs. API-only onboarding, managed vs. custom payouts, and outsourced vs. self-configured risk monitoring. This implies some room to take on more control without replatforming. Nothing in the pack addresses moving from a managed model to registered payment facilitator status, or the change in liability and economics that comes with it. Missing for 10: any documented path to registered payfac status, explicit liability/merchant-of-record model tiers, evidence of improved economics on graduation, independent corroboration of migrating without replatforming.
